kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly (KJV 75:2)
mine: At the set time that I appoint I will judge with equity
note: ki 'eqqah mo'ed: mo'ed is "an appointed time" (God speaking), not "congregation"; God chooses his moment for judgment.

kjv: For promotion [cometh] neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south (KJV 75:6)
mine: For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes lifting up
note: midbar harim can be "the wilderness of the mountains" (the south) or "the wilderness (does not bring) lifting up" (harim "to raise"); the KJV supplies "promotion" and "south".
